decisions.reason: Having survived its first full year without a visible shortfall and fitting existing display capabilities, it likely remains at or above aspiration and is worth retaining.

Because the online portal is distant from the firm's narrow physical-display core and has no clear success signal yet, it carries the highest aspiration risk, but strategic relevance for customer collaboration and some organisational slack support keeping it for now.
The award-winning packaging display solution clearly exceeds aspiration and strengthens the firm's core innovative offer, so withdrawal is very unlikely.

This quarter-pallet cardboard pegboard display is close to the established product base and uses existing design, printing, and assembly resources, so absent negative results it is likely to be retained.
The small cardboard counter display is a close-to-core extension that can be carried with little extra search cost, though its more standardised nature leaves a modest risk if demand underwhelms.
The large freestanding cardboard information display fits the firm's core one-stop display business and current production assets, so launch uncertainty alone is unlikely to trigger withdrawal.
